headerDisplay: HomeKit support for the FHEM home automation system. See the [documentation](https://github.com/bircni/fhemgate#documentation) for all options, device types and the homebridgeMapping attribute.
footerDisplay: Find out more about FHEM on its [project page](https://fhem.de).

server.title: Server
server.description: IP Address / Hostname of the FHEM server

filter.title: Filter
filter.description: devspec that matches the devices that should be exported to homebridge.

ssl.title: Use https
ssl.description: use ssl/https when connecting to fhem

rejectUnauthorized.title: Verify the certificate
rejectUnauthorized.description: with ssl: on to only talk to a fhem whose certificate is trusted, off to accept any certificate. if not set, the certificate is not checked when user and password are configured, and checked when they are not.

webname.title: Webname
webname.description: the webname of the FHEMWEB instance. fhem if not given.

auth.title: Login
auth.#description: user & password for this FHEM connection

jsFunctions.title: Functions file
jsFunctions.description: a file with functions that mappings can name as reading2homekit and homekit2reading. absolute, or relative to the storage directory of homebridge. it is loaded as code.

scope.title: Scope
scope.description: the scopes this platform serves, separated by commas. the devices are published unless scopes are given and siri is not one of them.

neverTimeout.title: Never give up
neverTimeout.description: not needed any more: fhem is tried for as long as homebridge runs, and the accessories stay meanwhile.

allowInlineFunctions.title: Allow JavaScript in mappings
allowInlineFunctions.description: allow a homebridgeMapping to carry the body of a JavaScript function as reading2homekit or homekit2reading. such code runs inside homebridge, so whoever can set attributes in fhem can run code there. switch this off unless you use it.

connections.title: More FHEM servers
connections.description: more fhem to publish the devices of, each with the fields above. device names have to differ between them: a device two of them list is published by one of them only.

migrateFrom.title: Moving from homebridge-fhem
migrateFrom.description: only when this entry was a platform of homebridge-fhem: what it said for platform. the accessories keep their rooms, scenes and automations in HomeKit. see docs/migration.md.

debugPort.title: Debug port
debugPort.description: port of the debug page, which shows the cached readings and the subscriptions. 8282 if not given, or 8283 when that is taken. 0 switches the page off.

debugHost.title: Debug address
debugHost.description: address the debug page listens on. all addresses of the machine if not given, so that anybody who reaches the port can read it. 127.0.0.1 restricts it to the machine homebridge runs on.
